goodreads.note: Set this once and the collection keeps itself current. Either paste a Goodreads profile or quotes-list URL into the 'Sync from Goodreads' workflow, which writes it here, or fill it in by hand. Accepts https://www.goodreads.com/user/show/<id>-<name>, https://www.goodreads.com/quotes/list/<id>, or the bare numeric id.
